name: dsh-opencode-autosync
description: DSH host plugin: automatically discover the live opencode.ai Go-tier model list and merge new model ids into the 'opencode-go' llm-pi-ai route. Runs once at dsh startup and again on an interval, add-only (never prunes). Bypasses dsh-llm-pi-ai's catalog short-circuit by calling llm.discoverModels without a catalog provider id, so opencode-go models that pi-ai's static catalog has not shipped yet appear automatically.
